ESV.1: “You shall not make idols for yourselves or erect an image or pillar, and you shall not set up a figured stone in your land to bow down to it, for I am the LORD your God.
ESV.2: You shall keep my Sabbaths and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
ESV.3: “If you walk in my statutes and observe my commandments and do them,
ESV.4: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
ESV.5: Your threshing shall last to the time of the grape harvest, and the grape harvest shall last to the time for sowing. And you shall eat your bread to the full and dwell in your land securely.
ESV.6: I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid. And I will remove harmful beasts from the land, and the sword shall not go through your land.
ESV.7: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
ESV.8: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand, and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
ESV.9: I will turn to you and make you fruitful and multiply you and will confirm my covenant with you.
ESV.10: You shall eat old store long kept, and you shall clear out the old to make way for the new.
ESV.11: I will make my dwelling  among you, and my soul shall not abhor you.
ESV.12: And I will walk among you and will be your God, and you shall be my people.
ESV.13: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. And I have broken the bars of your yoke and made you walk erect.
ESV.14: “But if you will not listen to me and will not do all these commandments,
ESV.15: if you spurn my statutes, and if your soul abhors my rules, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,
ESV.16: then I will do this to you: I will visit you with panic, with wasting disease and fever that consume the eyes and make the heart ache. And you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
ESV.17: I will set my face against you, and you shall be struck down before your enemies. Those who hate you shall rule over you, and you shall flee when none pursues you.
ESV.18: And if in spite of this you will not listen to me, then I will discipline you again sevenfold for your sins,
ESV.19: and I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your heavens like iron and your earth like bronze.
ESV.20: And your strength shall be spent in vain, for your land shall not yield its increase, and the trees of the land shall not yield their fruit.
ESV.21: “Then if you walk contrary to me and will not listen to me, I will continue striking you, sevenfold for your sins.
ESV.22: And I will let loose the wild beasts against you, which shall bereave you of your children and destroy your livestock and make you few in number, so that your roads shall be deserted.
ESV.23: “And if by this discipline you are not turned to me but walk contrary to me,
ESV.24: then I also will walk contrary to you, and I myself will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
ESV.25: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall execute vengeance for the covenant. And if you gather within your cities, I will send pestilence among you, and you shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
ESV.26: When I break your supply  of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in a single oven and shall dole out your bread again by weight, and you shall eat and not be satisfied.
ESV.27: “But if in spite of this you will not listen to me, but walk contrary to me,
ESV.28: then I will walk contrary to you in fury, and I myself will discipline you sevenfold for your sins.
ESV.29: You shall eat the flesh of your sons, and you shall eat the flesh of your daughters.
ESV.30: And I will destroy your high places and cut down your incense altars and cast your dead bodies upon the dead bodies of your idols, and my soul will abhor you.
ESV.31: And I will lay your cities waste and will make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell your pleasing aromas.
ESV.32: And I myself will devastate the land, so that your enemies who settle in it shall be appalled at it.
ESV.33: And I will scatter you among the nations, and I will unsheathe the sword after you, and your land shall be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
ESV.34: “Then the land shall enjoy  its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate, while you are in your enemies' land; then the land shall rest, and enjoy its Sabbaths.
ESV.35: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, the rest that it did not have on your Sabbaths when you were dwelling in it.
ESV.36: And as for those of you who are left, I will send faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf shall put them to flight, and they shall flee as one flees from the sword, and they shall fall when none pursues.
ESV.37: They shall stumble over one another, as if to escape a sword, though none pursues. And you shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
ESV.38: And you shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
ESV.39: And those of you who are left shall rot away in your enemies' lands because of their iniquity, and also because of the iniquities of their fathers they shall rot away like them.
ESV.40: “But if they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers in their treachery that they committed against me, and also in walking contrary to me,
ESV.41: so that I walked contrary to them and brought them into the land of their enemies — if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled and they make amends for their iniquity,
ESV.42: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, and I will remember my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
ESV.43: But the land shall be abandoned by them and enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them, and they shall make amends for their iniquity, because they spurned my rules and their soul abhorred my statutes.
ESV.44: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not spurn them, neither will I abhor them so as to destroy them utterly and break my covenant with them, for I am the LORD their God.
ESV.45: But I will for their sake remember the covenant with their forefathers, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.”
ESV.46: These are the statutes and rules and laws that the LORD made between himself and the people of Israel through Moses on Mount Sinai.

NASB.10: 'You will eat the old supply and clear out the old because of the new.

NASB.12: 'I will also walk among you and be your God, and you shall be My people.
NASB.13: 'I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that [you] would not be their slaves, and I broke the bars of your yoke and made you walk erect.
NASB.14: 'But if you do not obey Me and do not carry out all these commandments,
NASB.15: if, instead, you reject My statutes, and if your soul abhors My ordinances so as not to carry out all My commandments, [and] so break My covenant,

NASB.18: 'If also after these things you do not obey Me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
NASB.19: 'I will also break down your pride of power; I will also make your sky like iron and your earth like bronze.
NASB.20: 'Your strength will be spent uselessly, for your land will not yield its produce and the trees of the land will not yield their fruit.
NASB.21: 'If then, you act with hostility against Me and are unwilling to obey Me, I will increase the plague on you seven times according to your sins.
NASB.22: 'I will let loose among you the beasts of the field, which will bereave you of your children and destroy your cattle and reduce your number so that your roads lie deserted.
NASB.23: 'And if by these things you are not turned to Me, but act with hostility against Me,
NASB.24: then I will act with hostility against you; and I, even I, will strike you seven times for your sins.
NASB.25: 'I will also bring upon you a sword which will execute vengeance for the covenant; and when you gather together into your cities, I will send pestilence among you, so that you shall be delivered into enemy hands.
NASB.26: 'When I break your staff of bread, ten women will bake your bread in one oven, and they will bring back your bread in rationed amounts, so that you will eat and not be satisfied.

NASB.28: then I will act with wrathful hostility against you, and I, even I, will punish you seven times for your sins.
NASB.29: 'Further, you will eat the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters you will eat.
NASB.30: 'I then will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and heap your remains on the remains of your idols, for My soul shall abhor you.
NASB.31: 'I will lay waste your cities as well and will make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell your soothing aromas.
NASB.32: 'I will make the land desolate so that your enemies who settle in it will be appalled over it.
NASB.33: 'You, however, I will scatter among the nations and will draw out a sword after you, as your land becomes desolate and your cities become waste.
NASB.34: 'Then the land will enjoy its sabbaths all the days of the desolation, while you are in your enemies' land; then the land will rest and enjoy its sabbaths.
NASB.35: 'All the days of [its] desolation it will observe the rest which it did not observe on your sabbaths, while you were living on it.
NASB.36: 'As for those of you who may be left, I will also bring weakness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. And the sound of a driven leaf will chase them, and even when no one is pursuing they will flee as though from the sword, and they will fall.

NASB.38: 'But you will perish among the nations, and your enemies' land will consume you.
NASB.39: 'So those of you who may be left will rot away because of their iniquity in the lands of your enemies; and also because of the iniquities of their forefathers they will rot away with them.
NASB.40: 'If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their forefathers, in their unfaithfulness which they committed against Me, and also in their acting with hostility against Me--
NASB.41: I also was acting with hostility against them, to bring them into the land of their enemies-- or if their uncircumcised heart becomes humbled so that they then make amends for their iniquity,
NASB.42: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob, and I will remember also My covenant with Isaac, and My covenant with Abraham as well, and I will remember the land.
NASB.43: 'For the land will be abandoned by them, and will make up for its sabbaths while it is made desolate without them. They, meanwhile, will be making amends for their iniquity, because they rejected My ordinances and their soul abhorred My statutes.
NASB.44: 'Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, nor will I so abhor them as to destroy them, breaking My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
NASB.45: 'But I will remember for them the covenant with their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.''

NKJV.1: ‘You shall not make idols for yourselves; neither a carved image nor a sacred pillar shall you rear up for yourselves; nor shall you set up an engraved stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.
NKJV.2: You shall keep My Sabbaths and reverence My sanctuary: I am the LORD.
NKJV.3: ‘If you walk in My statutes and keep My commandments, and perform them,
NKJV.4: then I will give you rain in its season, the land shall yield its produce, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
NKJV.5: Your threshing shall last till the time of vintage, and the vintage shall last till the time of sowing; you shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
NKJV.6: I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and none will make you afraid; I will rid the land of evil beasts, and the sword will not go through your land.
NKJV.7: You will chase your enemies, and they shall fall by the sword before you.
NKJV.8: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight; your enemies shall fall by the sword before you.
NKJV.9: ‘For I will look on you favorably and make you fruitful, multiply you and confirm My covenant with you.
NKJV.10: You shall eat the old harvest, and clear out the old because of the new.
NKJV.11: I will set My tabernacle among you, and My soul shall not abhor you.
NKJV.12: I will walk among you and be your God, and you shall be My people.
NKJV.13: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves; I have broken the bands of your yoke and made you walk upright.
NKJV.14: ‘But if you do not obey Me, and do not observe all these commandments,
NKJV.15: and if you despise My statutes, or if your soul abhors My judgments, so that you do not perform all My commandments, but break My covenant,
NKJV.16: I also will do this to you: I will even appoint terror over you, wasting disease and fever which shall consume the eyes and cause sorrow of heart. And you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
NKJV.17: I will set My face against you, and you shall be defeated by your enemies.  Those who hate you shall reign over you, and you shall flee when no one pursues you.
NKJV.18: ‘And after all this, if you do not obey Me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
NKJV.19: I will break the pride of your power; I will make your heavens like iron and your earth like bronze.
NKJV.20: And your strength shall be spent in vain; for your land shall not yield its produce, nor shall the trees of the land yield their fruit.
NKJV.21: ‘Then, if you walk contrary to Me, and are not willing to obey Me, I will bring on you seven times more plagues, according to your sins.
NKJV.22: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number; and your highways shall be desolate.
NKJV.23: ‘And if by these things you are not reformed by Me, but walk contrary to Me,
NKJV.24: then I also will walk contrary to you, and I will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
NKJV.25: And I will bring a sword against you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant; when you are gathered together within your cities I will send pestilence among you; and you shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
NKJV.26: When I have cut off your supply of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall bring back your bread by weight, and you shall eat and not be satisfied.
NKJV.27: ‘And after all this, if you do not obey Me, but walk contrary to Me,
NKJV.28: then I also will walk contrary to you in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
NKJV.29: You shall eat the flesh of your sons, and you shall eat the flesh of your daughters.
NKJV.30: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and cast your carcasses on the lifeless forms of your idols; and My soul shall abhor you.
NKJV.31: I will lay your cities waste and bring your sanctuaries to desolation, and I will not smell the fragrance of your sweet aromas.
NKJV.32: I will bring the land to desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it shall be astonished at it.
NKJV.33: I will scatter you among the nations and draw out a sword after you; your land shall be desolate and your cities waste.
NKJV.34: Then the land shall enjoy its sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land; then the land shall rest and enjoy its sabbaths.
NKJV.35: As long as it lies desolate it shall rest— for the time it did not rest on your sabbaths when you dwelt in it.
NKJV.36: ‘And as for those of you who are left, I will send faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; the sound of a shaken leaf shall cause them to flee; they shall flee as though fleeing from a sword, and they shall fall when no one pursues.
NKJV.37: They shall stumble over one another, as it were before a sword, when no one pursues; and you shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
NKJV.38: You shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
NKJV.39: And those of you who are left shall waste away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; also in their fathers’ iniquities, which are with them, they shall waste away.
NKJV.40: ‘But if they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, with their unfaithfulness in which they were unfaithful to Me, and that they also have walked contrary to Me,
NKJV.41: and that I also have walked contrary to them and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if their uncircumcised hearts are humbled, and they accept their guilt—
NKJV.42: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob, and My covenant with Isaac and My covenant with Abraham I will remember; I will remember the land.
NKJV.43: The land also shall be left empty by them, and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; they will accept their guilt, because they despised My judgments and because their soul abhorred My statutes.
NKJV.44: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, nor shall I abhor them, to utterly destroy them and break My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
NKJV.45: But for their sake I will remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.’ ”
NKJV.46: These are the statutes and judgments and laws which the LORD made between Himself and the children of Israel on Mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

NLT.1: “Do not make idols or set up carved images, or sacred pillars, or sculptured stones in your land so you may worship them. I am the LORD your God.
NLT.2: You must keep my Sabbath days of rest and show reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.
NLT.3: “If you follow my decrees and are careful to obey my commands,
NLT.4: I will send you the seasonal rains. The land will then yield its crops, and the trees of the field will produce their fruit.
NLT.5: Your threshing season will overlap with the grape harvest, and your grape harvest will overlap with the season of planting grain. You will eat your fill and live securely in your own land.
NLT.6: “I will give you peace in the land, and you will be able to sleep with no cause for fear. I will rid the land of wild animals and keep your enemies out of your land.
NLT.7: In fact, you will chase down your enemies and slaughter them with your swords.
NLT.8: Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand! All your enemies will fall beneath your sword.
NLT.9: “I will look favorably upon you, making you fertile and multiplying your people. And I will fulfill my covenant with you.
NLT.10: You will have such a surplus of crops that you will need to clear out the old grain to make room for the new harvest!
NLT.11: I will live among you, and I will not despise you.
NLT.12: I will walk among you; I will be your God, and you will be my people.
NLT.13: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so you would no longer be their slaves. I broke the yoke of slavery from your neck so you can walk with your heads held high.
NLT.14: “However, if you do not listen to me or obey all these commands,
NLT.15: and if you break my covenant by rejecting my decrees, treating my regulations with contempt, and refusing to obey my commands,
NLT.16: I will punish you. I will bring sudden terrors upon you — wasting diseases and burning fevers that will cause your eyes to fail and your life to ebb away. You will plant your crops in vain because your enemies will eat them.
NLT.17: I will turn against you, and you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will run even when no one is chasing you!
NLT.18: “And if, in spite of all this, you still disobey me, I will punish you seven times over for your sins.
NLT.19: I will break your proud spirit by making the skies as unyielding as iron and the earth as hard as bronze.
NLT.20: All your work will be for nothing, for your land will yield no crops, and your trees will bear no fruit.
NLT.21: “If even then you remain hostile toward me and refuse to obey me, I will inflict disaster on you seven times over for your sins.
NLT.22: I will send wild animals that will rob you of your children and destroy your livestock. Your numbers will dwindle, and your roads will be deserted.
NLT.23: “And if you fail to learn the lesson and continue your hostility toward me,
NLT.24: then I myself will be hostile toward you. I will personally strike you with calamity seven times over for your sins.
NLT.25: I will send armies against you to carry out the curse of the covenant you have broken. When you run to your towns for safety, I will send a plague to destroy you there, and you will be handed over to your enemies.
NLT.26: I will destroy your food supply, so that ten women will need only one oven to bake bread for their families. They will ration your food by weight, and though you have food to eat, you will not be satisfied.
NLT.27: “If in spite of all this you still refuse to listen and still remain hostile toward me,
NLT.28: then I will give full vent to my hostility. I myself will punish you seven times over for your sins.
NLT.29: Then you will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.
NLT.30: I will destroy your pagan shrines and knock down your places of worship. I will leave your lifeless corpses piled on top of your lifeless idols, and I will despise you.
NLT.31: I will make your cities desolate and destroy your places of pagan worship. I will take no pleasure in your offerings that should be a pleasing aroma to me.
NLT.32: Yes, I myself will devastate your land, and your enemies who come to occupy it will be appalled at what they see.
NLT.33: I will scatter you among the nations and bring out my sword against you. Your land will become desolate, and your cities will lie in ruins.
NLT.34: Then at last the land will enjoy its neglected Sabbath years as it lies desolate while you are in exile in the land of your enemies. Then the land will finally rest and enjoy the Sabbaths it missed.
NLT.35: As long as the land lies in ruins, it will enjoy the rest you never allowed it to take every seventh year while you lived in it.
NLT.36: “And for those of you who survive, I will demoralize you in the land of your enemies. You will live in such fear that the sound of a leaf driven by the wind will send you fleeing. You will run as though fleeing from a sword, and you will fall even when no one pursues you.
NLT.37: Though no one is chasing you, you will stumble over each other as though fleeing from a sword. You will have no power to stand up against your enemies.
NLT.38: You will die among the foreign nations and be devoured in the land of your enemies.
NLT.39: Those of you who survive will waste away in your enemies’ lands because of their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
NLT.40: “But at last my people will confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors for betraying me and being hostile toward me.
NLT.41: When I have turned their hostility back on them and brought them to the land of their enemies, then at last their stubborn hearts will be humbled, and they will pay for their sins.
NLT.42: Then I will remember my covenant with Jacob and my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
NLT.43: For the land must be abandoned to enjoy its years of Sabbath rest as it lies deserted. At last the people will pay for their sins, for they have continually rejected my regulations and despised my decrees.
NLT.44: “But despite all this, I will not utterly reject or despise them while they are in exile in the land of their enemies. I will not cancel my covenant with them by wiping them out, for I am the LORD their God.
NLT.45: For their sakes I will remember my ancient covenant with their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of all the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.”
NLT.46: These are the decrees, regulations, and instructions that the LORD gave through Moses on Mount Sinai as evidence of the relationship between himself and the Israelites.

AMP.1: 'You shall not make idols for yourselves, nor shall you erect an image, a sacred pillar or an obelisk, nor shall you place any figured stone in your land so that you may bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.
AMP.2: You shall keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
AMP.3: If you walk in My statutes and keep My commandments and [obediently] do them,
AMP.4: then I will give you rain in its season, and the land will yield her produce and the trees of the field bear their fruit.
AMP.5: And your threshing season will last until grape gathering and the grape gathering [time] will last until planting, and you will eat your bread and be filled and live securely in your land.
AMP.6: I will also grant peace in the land, so that you may lie down and there will be no one to make you afraid. I will also eliminate harmful animals from the land, and no sword will pass through your land.
AMP.7: And you will chase your enemies, and they will fall before you by the sword.
AMP.8: Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will put ten thousand to flight; your enemies will fall before you by the sword.
AMP.9: For I will turn toward you [with favor and regard] and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish and confirm My covenant with you.
AMP.10: You will eat the old supply of [abundant] produce, and clear out the old [to make room] for the new.
AMP.11: I will make My dwelling among you, and My soul will not reject nor separate itself from you.
AMP.12: I will walk among you and be your God, and you shall be My people.
AMP.13: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would not be their slaves; and I broke the bars of your yoke and made you walk upright [with heads held high as free men].
AMP.14: 'But if you do not obey Me and do not [obediently] do all these commandments,
AMP.15: if, instead, you reject My statutes, and if your soul rejects My ordinances, so that you will not [obediently] do all My commandments, and in this way break My covenant,
AMP.16: I, in turn, will do this to you: I will appoint over you sudden terror, consumption, and fever that will waste away the eyes and cause the soul to languish also. And you will sow your seed uselessly, for your enemies will eat what you plant.
AMP.17: I will set My face against you so that you will be struck down before your enemies; those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one is pursuing you.
AMP.18: If in spite of all this you still will not listen to Me and be obedient, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
AMP.19: I will break your pride in your power, and I will make your sky like iron [giving no rain and blocking all prayers] and your ground like bronze [hard to plow and yielding no produce].
AMP.20: Your strength will be spent uselessly, for your land will not yield its produce and the trees of the land will not yield their fruit.
AMP.21: 'If then, you act with hostility toward Me and are unwilling to obey Me, I will increase the plague on you seven times in accordance with your sins.
AMP.22: I will let loose the [wild] animals of the field among you, which will bereave you of your children and destroy your livestock and make you so few in number that your roads will lie deserted and desolate.
AMP.23: 'And if by these things you are not turned to Me, but act with hostility against Me,
AMP.24: then I also will act with hostility against you, and I will strike you seven times for your sins.
AMP.25: I will bring a sword on you that will execute vengeance for [breaking] the covenant; and when you gather together in your cities, I will send pestilence (virulent disease) among you, and you shall be handed over to the enemy.
AMP.26: When I break your staff of bread [that is, cut off your supply of food], ten women will bake your bread in one oven, and they will ration your bread; and you will eat and not be satisfied.
AMP.27: 'Yet if in spite of this you will not [attentively] listen to Me but act with hostility against me,
AMP.28: then I will act with hostility against you in wrath, and I also will punish you seven times for your sins.
AMP.29: You will eat the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters.
AMP.30: I will destroy your high places [devoted to idolatrous worship], and cut down your incense altars, and heap your dead bodies upon the [crushed] bodies of your idols, and My soul will detest you [with deep and unutterable loathing].
AMP.31: I will lay waste your cities as well and will make your sanctuaries desolate, and I will not smell your sweet and soothing aromas [of offerings by fire].
AMP.32: I will make the land desolate, and your enemies who settle in it will be appalled at it.
AMP.33: I will scatter you among the nations and draw out the sword [of your enemies] after you; your land will become desolate and your cities will become ruins.

AMP.35: As long as it lies desolate, it will have rest, the rest it did not have on your Sabbaths, while you were living on it.
AMP.36: As for those who are left of you, I will bring despair (lack of courage, weakness) into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; the sound of a scattered leaf will put them to flight, and they will flee as if [running] from the sword, and will fall even when no one is chasing them.
AMP.37: They shall stumble over one another as if to escape from a sword when no one is chasing them; and you will have no power to stand before your enemies.
AMP.38: You will perish among the nations; the land of your enemies will consume you.
AMP.39: Those of you who are left will rot away because of their wickedness in the lands of your enemies; also because of the wickedness of their forefathers they will rot away like them.
AMP.40: 'If they confess their wickedness and the wickedness of their forefathers, in their unfaithfulness which they have committed against Me—and also in their acting with hostility toward Me—

AMP.42: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob, and also My covenant with Isaac, and also My covenant with Abraham, and remember the land.
AMP.43: But the land will be abandoned by them and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment for their wickedness and make amends because they rejected My ordinances and their soul rejected My statutes.
AMP.44: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, nor will I so despise them as to destroy them, breaking My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
AMP.45: But I will, for their sake, [earnestly] remember the covenant with their forefathers, whom I have brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.'"

CSB17.8: Five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand; your enemies will fall before you by the sword. <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.9: “I will turn to you, make you fruitful and multiply you, and confirm my covenant with you.
CSB17.10: You will eat the old grain of the previous year and will clear out the old to make room for the new.
CSB17.11: I will place my residence <sup>[1]</sup> among you, and I will not reject you. <sup>ⓓ</sup>
CSB17.12: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people. <sup>ⓔ</sup>
CSB17.13: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, so that you would no longer be their slaves. I broke the bars of your yoke <sup>ⓕ</sup> and enabled you to live in freedom. <sup>[2]</sup>
CSB17.14: “But if you do not obey me and observe all these commands —
CSB17.15: if you reject my statutes and despise my ordinances, and do not observe all my commands — and break my covenant,
CSB17.16: then I will do this to you: I will bring terror <sup>ⓖ</sup> on you — wasting disease and fever that will cause your eyes to fail and your life to ebb away. You will sow your seed in vain because your enemies will eat it.
CSB17.17: I will turn <sup>[3]</sup> against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee even though no one is pursuing you. <sup>ⓗ</sup>
CSB17.18: “But if after these things you will not obey me, I will proceed to discipline you seven times for your sins. <sup>ⓘ</sup>
CSB17.19: I will break down your strong pride. I will make your sky like iron and your land like bronze,
CSB17.20: and your strength will be used up for nothing. <sup>ⓙ</sup> Your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.
CSB17.21: “If you act with hostility toward me and are unwilling to obey me, I will multiply your plagues seven times for your sins. <sup>ⓚ</sup>
CSB17.22: I will send wild animals against you that will deprive you of your children, ravage your livestock, and reduce your numbers until your roads are deserted. <sup>ⓛ</sup>
CSB17.23: “If in spite of these things you do not accept my discipline, but act with hostility toward me,
CSB17.24: then I will act with hostility toward you; I also will strike you seven times for your sins.
CSB17.25: I will bring a sword against you <sup>ⓜ</sup> to execute the vengeance of the covenant. Though you withdraw into your cities, I will send a pestilence among you, and you will be delivered into enemy hands.
CSB17.26: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and ration out your bread by weight, so that you will eat but not be satisfied. <sup>ⓝ</sup>
CSB17.27: “And if in spite of this you do not obey me but act with hostility toward me,
CSB17.28: I will act with furious hostility toward you; I will also discipline you seven times for your sins.
CSB17.29: You will eat the flesh of your sons; you will eat the flesh of your daughters. <sup>ⓐ</sup>
CSB17.30: I will destroy your high places, cut down your shrines, <sup>[4]</sup> and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless bodies of your idols; <sup>ⓑ</sup> I will reject you.
CSB17.31: I will reduce your cities to ruins and devastate your sanctuaries. I will not smell the pleasing aroma of your sacrifices. <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.32: I also will devastate the land, so that your enemies who come to live there will be appalled by it.
CSB17.33: But I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw a sword to chase after you. So your land will become desolate, and your cities will become ruins.
CSB17.34: “Then the land will make up for its Sabbath years during the time it lies desolate, while you are in the land of your enemies. At that time the land will rest and make up for its Sabbaths.
CSB17.35: As long as it lies desolate, it will have the rest it did not have during your Sabbaths when you lived there.
CSB17.36: “I will put anxiety in the hearts of those of you who survive in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a wind-driven leaf will put them to flight, and they will flee as one flees from a sword, and fall though no one is pursuing them.
CSB17.37: They will stumble over one another as if fleeing from a sword though no one is pursuing them. You will not be able to stand against your enemies.
CSB17.38: You will perish among the nations; the land of your enemies will devour you.
CSB17.39: Those <sup>[5]</sup> who survive in the lands of your enemies will waste away because of their iniquity; they will also waste away because of their fathers’ iniquities along with theirs.
CSB17.40: “But when they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers — their unfaithfulness that they practiced against me, and how they acted with hostility toward me,
CSB17.41: and I acted with hostility toward them and brought them into the land of their enemies — and when their uncircumcised hearts are humbled <sup>ⓓ</sup> and they make amends for their iniquity,
CSB17.42: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob. I will also remember my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
CSB17.43: For the land abandoned by them will make up for its Sabbaths by lying desolate without the people, while they make amends for their iniquity, because they rejected my ordinances and abhorred my statutes.
CSB17.44: Yet in spite of this, while they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject or abhor them so as to destroy them and break my covenant with them, since I am the LORD their God. <sup>ⓔ</sup>
CSB17.45: For their sake I will remember the covenant with their fathers, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations to be their God; I am the LORD.”
CSB17.46: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws the LORD established between himself and the Israelites through Moses on Mount Sinai.

NIV.35: All the time that it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not have during the sabbaths you lived in it.
NIV.36: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will make their hearts so fearful in the lands of their enemies that the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. They will run as though fleeing from the sword, and they will fall, even though no one is pursuing them.
NIV.37: They will stumble over one another as though fleeing from the sword, even though no one is pursuing them. So you will not be able to stand before your enemies.
NIV.38: You will perish among the nations; the land of your enemies will devour you.
NIV.39: Those of you who are left will waste away in the lands of their enemies because of their sins; also because of their fathers’ sins they will waste away.
NIV.40: “‘But if they will confess their sins and the sins of their fathers—their treachery against me and their hostility toward me,
NIV.41: which made me hostile toward them so that I sent them into the land of their enemies—then when their uncircumcised hearts are humbled and they pay for their sin,
NIV.42: I will remember my covenant with Jacob and my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
NIV.43: For the land will be deserted by them and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them. They will pay for their sins because they rejected my laws and abhorred my decrees.
NIV.44: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them or abhor them so as to destroy them completely, breaking my covenant with them. I am the Lord their God.
NIV.45: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their ancestors whom I brought out of Egypt in the sight of the nations to be their God. I am the Lord.’”
NIV.46: These are the decrees, the laws and the regulations that the Lord established on Mount Sinai between himself and the Israelites through Moses.
